review_note: Area and component breakdown distinguishes hectares, point elements and farm-level monitoring. Overall funding/admission is separate from these raw component calculations.

common.is_arable/is_grassland correctly distinguish agricultural arable/grassland, while separate modules handle point elements and hedges. Shared aggregations do not filter foreign parcels consistently; general ATB-LAGE-001 findings apply. Scope is not a positive funding/admission decision.

Vertragszeilen 2023–2025 und Ende 2028 sind korrekt als Daten vorhanden; contract_active bleibt außerhalb der Gesamtentscheidung. Fehlender Beginn/abgelaufenes Jahr verhindert positives access_conditions_met nicht.
Einjährige Start-/Endmetadaten werden berechnet; kein vollständiger jährlicher Antrags-/Abmelde-/Verpflichtungsnachweis.
contract_active prüft nur Jahresbereich; historische Flächenidentität und Weiterbewirtschaftung aller Zugänge sind nicht erfasst, und der Helfer ist nicht in decision eingebunden.
Verspätetes bekanntes Datum wird erkannt; null/fehlendes Datum oder fehlender Beginn produziert keinen Fristverstoß und kein missing_inputs-Signal.
Bekannter Vertragsbeginn >2025 erzeugt den passenden Verstoß; ersetzt keinen positiven Nachweis des konkreten Vertrags.

Application deadline and latest first year are diagnosed, but monitoring_eligible and monitoring_premium do not depend on monitoring_application_ok; late application still produces raw premium. Automatic renewal/deregistration is not represented. Final-year/date validity is not checked.
Exakte native Codes 1A/1B und expliziter Teilbetriebs-Ausnahmeflag steuern den Ausschluss. Keine unabhängige Prüfung des Umfangs des Bio-Teilbetriebs.
Native Unterkategorie 1C_nichtproduktive_ackerflaechen wird ausgeschlossen; der Adapter muss diesen von Agroforst unterscheiden.

Module excludes LSE-only parcel codes and participating Bergmaehder. Full Annex-L cross-measure combinations, selected option and actual parcel participation require root/general/table audit; a farm participation set is not a parcel eligibility proof.
Raw premium combines the named UBB components additively. This statement does not establish whether all other obligations or cross-measure combinations are met.

DIV and DIVRS excluded from FWK payment. No full parcel-level exclusion against every other UBB top-up is implemented: WB, SLK or PZR can still calculate on a DIV-coded parcel if their own conditions are supplied. External measure payments are not known.

Credited NAT/EBW/BAW/AG/N2 DIV excluded from base and DIV top-ups; other arable top-up eligibility predicates do not uniformly apply credited_from_other_measure/lse_only, so raw SLK/WB/PZR/FWK amounts may remain on excluded combinations.
0,30-Schwelle ist einschließlich richtig; fehlende Kategorie/Bestand/Futterfläche wird zu nicht-tierhaltend, ohne Vollständigkeitshinweis.

Tabellenfaktoren werden verwendet. Tagesgenaue Altersanteile, Stichtags-/Durchschnittsbegründung sind extern vorzuberechnen; fehlende Kategorien werden still ausgelassen. Zulässiges average_count:null ist nicht nullsicher.
Grünland und die sieben Ackerfutterlabels zählen einschließlich NAT/Bergmähder. Österreich-/Beantragungsstatus wird im Nenner nicht gefiltert.
Betriebsstrukturwechsel bleibt Textkatalog ohne Rego und ohne Datum-/Herdzuordnungsmodell.
1,00-ha-Grenze und Referenzformel funktionieren bei vollständigen voraufbereiteten Werten. Fehlendes Objekt überspringt Prüfung; fehlende Komponenten werden 0.
Aktuelles Grünland füllt Toleranz rechnerisch auf. Innerbetrieblicher Zug-um-Zug-Tausch im gleichen MFA ist als aggregierte Eingabe vorausgesetzt, nicht geprüft.
Explizit übergebener inter_farm_swap_gain_ha wird abgezogen. Fehlend wird 0 angenommen; keine eigenständige Transaktions-/MFA-Prüfung.

Es gibt weder Vorvertrags-Umbruchdatum noch AMA-Bestätigung im vorgeschlagenen Objekt. Die Ausnahme kann nur extern in die Summen eingerechnet werden; bloße Bindung an grassland_reference_ha belegt sie nicht.
>5-ha- und >75%-Grenze numerisch richtig. Deutsche Tabellenlabels und ggf. cereal_share_percent müssen korrekt voraufbereitet sein; ausländische Flächen bleiben im Anteil.
>55% sowie Futter-/ab2025-Brache/Spargel-Ausnahmen funktionieren für exakte native Artenlabels. Fehlende botanische Art fällt auf nicht vereinheitlichte Nutzungslabels zurück.
Agricultural-Ackerflächen einschließlich NAT/EBW/Brache zählen; LSE/MNH/Agroforst anderer area_kind nicht. Österreichfilter fehlt.
culture liest ein frei eingegebenes botanisches Artlabel. Keine Normalisierung Winter/Sommer, Körner-/Silomais, Erstkultur oder Hauptanteil. Die kommentierte Semantik ist eine externe Vorbedingung.
Getreideanteil <50 wird bei bekanntem cereal_share_percent ausgeschlossen. Hauptart wird extern übergeben, sonst Getreideanteil 100 angenommen.
3h, 2022–2025, anerkannter Anbieter und Biodiversitätsbezug werden geprüft. Verstoß erst ab year>=2026; Bedeutung eines abgeschlossenen Förderjahres 2025 ist damit separat zu klären.
applicant/involved_person ist zulässig; maßgebliche Tätigkeit/Bewirtschaftungseinbindung muss die Eingabe belegen. Fehlender Teilnehmer wird applicant.
Datumsfenster und credited_to_other_farm-Flag werden geprüft. Fehlender Mehrfachanrechnungsflag wird false.
attendee_left_before_deadline schließt anrechenbaren Kurs aus. Datum der Betriebszugehörigkeit selbst wird nicht geprüft.
Vorlage/Aufforderung/Übermittlung der Kursbestätigung bleibt Verfahrensbeschreibung; keine automatische Entscheidung ohne solche Tatsachen behaupten.
credited_to_other_obligation schließt Kurs aus; fehlend wird false. Keine Kursidentität gegen andere Programme.
More-than-2ha threshold, 7% and no AZR exemption from farm minimum are implemented. Denominator classification depends on supplied land_use/area_kind and root common-module review.

Exactly 10ha follows old SRL wording bis 10ha (<=), while April2026 infosheet p6 says unter10ha. Native assumptions explicitly record hierarchy choice. Combined area and independent grassland minimum follow the 9ha+5ha example. Do not call the boundary an unequivocal code defect before resolving source version hierarchy.
Voluntary small-farm DIV can receive base and top-ups; no minimum-arable-area restriction is added to these raw components. Exactly2ha is outside compulsory >2 threshold.

Farm >=10ha, field-piece >5ha and sum >=0.15ha implemented. Requires an authoritative field_piece_id: absent IDs fall back to parcel identity and can split one large field into small pieces (root input-contract issue).
Associated GLÖZ landscape elements and 2025+ agroforestry count only in field-piece credit. Their identity/association and area_kind are trusted input facts.

Only all-parcels AZR coding and year2023 are checked. Prior2022 neonicotinoid sugar beet and <0.15ha other crops are not checked; permitted following-crop list is stored but unused. Native assumptions deliberately approximate substantive exception by declaration code.

NAT requires SA01, not used, Grünbrache; EBW requires Grünbrache. Project-confirmation obligations are delegated rather than executed, and nature_area_used defaults false. No verified project evidence object is required.
K20 directly blocks arable-DIV credit.

DIV-coded Mehrnutzenhecke credited on aggregate herbaceous_div_care_compliant, default true. Distinction between trimming woody plants and herbaceous-area care is not calculated from events. Hedge eligibility is not required for DIV credit.
BAW/AG credit is guarded by aggregate div_care_compliant default true, not the computed management violations. Same parcel can be credited even when supplied events violate care obligations.
GLÖZ8 stops in2025; aggregate div_conditions_compliant defaults true for GLÖZ4/8. Event-derived violations do not remove farm-minimum credit.

7 insect-pollinated partners,3families,<=10% non-insect partners checked as supplied numeric aggregates, only in new-sowing year and outside documented exemptions. Species/family evidence itself is not derived or verified.
Latest May15 date checked for first-declared new-sowing year. No lower date/year bound: arbitrary older sowing_date is accepted; later resowing years are not directly covered by new_sowing_year.

Sep15 second year / Aug1 with winter/catch crop, predecessor establishment year and loss-of-control/grassland exceptions represented. Sanitation/resowing does not suppress ordinary minimum-age violation, so authorized reseeding before two years can still be diagnosed. Management remains dependent on supplied establishment_year.
Grünbrache breakup plus used_after_breakup_same_year triggers prohibition. Actual post-breakup use events are not inspected: positive/negative conclusion relies on the aggregate boolean.
Recognized force-majeure flag required when resown_after_destruction=true. Proof, original unavoidable event and compliant replacement mixture are not linked to the remediation event.

Weed remediation requires weed_evidence_kept. Zug-um-Zug replacement and originally timely/correct sowing are not checked, and ordinary breakup/new-sowing rules are not reconciled with this exception.

Same-location two-MFA check runs only when breakup_date exists and only own_managed, although p10 explicitly includes credited areas without reseeding. Missing consecutive_years_same_location defaults2; seed traceability outside first year is not checked.

Named exemption category, exemption_evidence_ok and no ploughing required. Exact continuous2020 declarations, former2015 codes,2021/22 DIV history and exclusion of WOH soil-health areas are delegated to that evidence flag.

Two-year minimum based on current use count and used_previous_year. Missing prior use defaults true. Before2025 grazing is counted as a use but separately diagnosed as forbidden, so not a positive compliance proof. Assumption restricts input to completed years.

Two uses (2026 OPUBB/OPBIO three), free first-year cleaning cut and post-grazing nonremoved care represented. post_grazing_care flag not tied to an immediately preceding grazing event; invasive exception suppresses all counted use types, although source only relaxes mowing/mulching.
Current-year thresh events on all arable DIV are diagnosed. General project precedence should be considered when used on NAT/EBW areas.
Grazing prohibited through2024 for directly UBB-managed arable DIV.
Aug1 grazing start and2026 coded exception implemented. Exclusive grazing does not require Schlagnutzungsart Ackerweide, since general permitted-code validation merely permits any DIV use type.

One post-Aug1 grazing after early mowing/mulching implemented, but required Sonstiges Feldfutter classification not checked. Third-use notice does not override this separate restriction; need hierarchy clarification for combined2026 patterns.

All DIV/DIVRS included; early project use consumes25% quota and native2026 no-premium areas excluded. Quota excludes invasive exceptions only during first2years, incorrectly rejecting older eligible invasive early cuts (MEASURE-04). Grazing and unsupported coded variants are not counted in mowed_before_august.

Free cleaning cut requires current first-declared year and a nonnull sowing date. Nonnull old date can establish exemption. Invalid cleaning cuts are diagnosed only beforeAug1, despite source restricting the special cleaning-cut category to reseeded first-year areas.

Single invasive_exception incorrectly restricts early mowing/mulching to first2years. Source p12 limits only >2 annual cuts to the two-year establishment period. No listed species or evidence requirement is actually checked; boolean invasive_species_present and aggregate share control exception (MEASURE-04).

Fertilization events checked from Jan1 first year with no cutoff at breakup/redeclaration, incorrectly diagnosing lawful post-breakup fertilization (MEASURE-03). BAW/AG are excluded through sowing_obligation; this follows their restricted care scope.

Missing organic approval is conservative for supplied PSM event. Like BM001 the active prohibition has no end at breakup/redeclaration. Missing/invalid date can suppress or break a check (root input validation).
Nonmechanical removal diagnosed; absent removal_method defaults mechanical, and specific tool list is not referenced. Absence of a removal event is not proof that one occurred mechanically.

Current driving purposes other than crossing diagnosed, but crossing purpose need not be to adjacent crops. Static irrigation/parking/storage without a driving event is unrepresented; default [] is treated as no evidence of misuse.

Numeric30species/7families/20kg and origin/documentation/max5% aggregates checked. Closed species tables not queried at runtime; ecotype_seed_used waives max-share constraint for whole mix without separate certified ecotype-component evidence. Source-backed adapter must validate constituent evidence.
Code diagnosed after2028 and eligibility limited<=2028; repeating annual applications is allowed. Contract admission is separate.
Continuous-DIVRS aggregate defaults true. False always fails; no representation of interrupted application followed by a valid new reseeding other than resetting supplied history fields.

Both2025variants, annual mow1–2/remove vs biennial mulch/max1/Oct1 and first-year cleaning exception represented. SFF mowing without removal is not independently forbidden if another removed mowing exists; first-year cleaning logic accepts nonnull sowing date without authenticating reseeding. Variant classification and core sowing/time obligations are separate from divrs_eligible.

Shared20% cap applied across two DIVRS variants, higher-rate SFF first. Root/general source-hierarchy review required for prioritization; paid eligibility does not depend on all other obligations (e.g. late initial sowing).

Year-specific DIV/DIVRS use-type table is applied for UBB-owned arable parcels. Composite simultaneous codes are not validated for exclusivity, and classification-specific grazing obligations remain gaps.
NAT/EBW with DIV must be Grünbrache. Missing DIV on an otherwise intended biodiversity parcel is not inferred; intention/declaration must be input.
BAW/AG with DIV limited to Grünbrache or Sonstiges Feldfutter. Required code is checked only on explicit DIV declarations.
More-than2ha mown-grassland threshold and7% implemented; denominator excludes Bergmaehder through common classification.
Voluntary DIV on small mown-grassland farms can receive raw base and top-ups. No obligatory minimum introduced at<=2ha.
Farm>=10ha mown and field-piece>5ha mown,0.15ha credit including associated GLÖZ LSE represented. Field grouping identity remains external evidence requirement.
NAT/N2 cut-date condition sets checked and only mown use types creditable; project actual management is delegated, rather than computed from project documents.

EBW credit relies on ebw_habitat_type_eligible=false default. Native code additionally accepts all common mown types including three-plus cuts if boolean true; habitat-type-specific one/two-cut classification is not verified. External EBW information sheet is not a supplied source.
Current-year PSM events require explicit organic_approved_only; missing flag rejects. Missing application date is not validated by this module, so complete event records remain necessary.

At least one mow with material removal in completed year implemented. Exactly-one-of-four variant code not enforced: multiple codes run multiple checks rather than reject ambiguous declaration. Special cleaning-cut use representation is inconsistent with DIVRS count (MEASURE-02).

Ordinary earliest=max(Jun15,min(comparable second cut,Jul15)); single-cut Jun15 implemented. Comparable status is reduced to date, without mown/not-grazed/farm-vs-neighbor/production-system proof. Drought path falsely permits first use before actual comparable second cut (MEASURE-01).
Advance limited above to10days but unverified input is applied directly; negative numbers postpone dates, no authoritative2026district map4–7days or date/source validation.
Current fertilization dates before first mowing/grazing trigger violation; missing first use yields no timing comparison and separate missing annual mow violation, not verified permission.

Mulch before/on first use prohibited and annual removed mow applied separately. Same-day order cannot be represented, so mulch after the first use on same date is conservatively diagnosed. Actual comparable-use evidence remains external.

63days/49coded2026 checked from supplied completion date; next activity at64th day passes. First-use completion is not derived from last wagon/bale transport or post-grazing care, and null skips interval enforcement.

Requires a mow/graze after supplied completion date. One-cut classification and after-Sep15 exceptional grazing semantics are not checked; completion date is not required to be an actual first use in the same year.

No mulch except post-grazing care checked, but both first and second use must remove/graze growth. A removed first mow plus second mow with material_removed=false returns violations[] (MEASURE-05). Full-cut equivalence for early grazing is also unrepresented.
Use-date documentation required through2024, no requirement from2025; aggregate flag remains evidence input.

Current use events and all fertilization/driving dates afterAug15 diagnosed; year filtering absent for latter can reject following-year operations even after lawful first use. No cross-year stop at next use; overwinter retained growth is not independently evidenced.
Prior DIVAGF requires current DIVSZ unless loss_of_control. Same parcel object is assumed same location; no geometry/lagegenau evidence or actual matching operation proof.

Most supplied site/mixture/date/fertilizer conditions implemented, but removed cleaning_cut is omitted from counting_uses and can yield three actual annual uses with divrs_eligible=true (MEASURE-02). Species lists and seedbed/device evidence not checked; mixture certification/provenance only aggregate fields; sowing only upper-bound May15.
Grassland biodiversity declarations restricted to four table use types. Multiple simultaneous variants not rejected, a separate contract gap.
NAT/EBW/N2 credited grassland DIV requires DIVSZ code.

Dimension/distance/control/application/full-year/no-Alm-Hutweide requirements implemented as element facts. No explicit tree/bush/tree-group type check; area lower bound and association with eligible agricultural field piece not validated. Geographic geometry is represented only by supplied distance.
Explicit is_gloez blocks LSE eligibility. Missing is_gloez defaults false rather than unknown; adapter must provide authoritative element classification.

80elements/ha field-piece cap and rates applied. Higher-rate streuobst prioritized under cap by an explicitly unsupported native assumption; source gives cap, not allocation order. Duplicate elements and missing field-piece IDs can distort counts.
Species/year/wild-form list, stem form, growth, no multi-tree permanent frame and SO checked. Depends on supplied botanical facts; exact list/value comparison delegated to tables audit.

SO coding required for streuobst rate; generic LSE Baeume/Buesche declaration type is not represented in element object, only applied_in_mfa. Ineligible SO can fall back to other-LSE rate; interpretation should be explicit.

Most aggregate site/date/concept/GIS/width/20%/care conditions checked. Missing woody_care_ok defaults true. Predominantly shrubs/fruit trees and single own-field-piece assignment not verified. fertilizer_or_psm_used boolean cannot distinguish permitted organic browsing protection from forbidden uses without an external normalization convention.
Hedge-eligible area times year rate; rate rows checked by tables audit.

Participation/intro/current annual complete data checked. For first_year<current, intro proof is assumed true even if explicitly intro_event_completed=false; no original first-year proof retained. Duplicate program objects can double farm-year payment.
Required Naturschutz participation and any matching condition across farm checked. Actual project/program recognition remains supplied facts and complete table review.

Sum per eligible object, not unique program per farm. Duplicate records inflate premium; late application still paid because eligibility ignores application_ok. Correct rate values separately table-audited.

Pure paid DIV excluding GLÖZ4 and other measures counted; arithmetic=max(0,min(pureDIV,20%denominator)-7%denominator), therefore payable maximum13% not20%. Clarify source cap meaning against SRL before accepting cap; infosheet itself does not resolve subtraction order unambiguously.
Soil index>=50 and20% cap checked on paid DIV. Weighted soil mean is supplied; no derivation from subareas or authoritative soil layer.

Ceil(arable/3) and strictly>0.05ha count; paid DIV area cap20%. Counts all credited DIV including other measures and hedge records per native assumption16, although source says Acker-Biodiversitaetsflaechen and does not expressly define this counting scope. Need precise field/parcel identity and duplication validation.
Distinct yearly SFF/Grünbrache rates, shared20% area cap. Exact rates checked by table audit; underlying eligibility gaps remain in DIVRSA001/004/005.

Exact variety-name match, pure/undersow/striped exceptions and seed documentation implemented. Botanical species/variety context not linked (root/table finding). Pure flag can override an explicitly true mixture flag; reused mixed-harvest poppy seed not modelled. Taxonomic wildcard entries require table audit.

10ha per variety and single parcel-object payment implemented; perennial first_use_year defaults current, thereby granting missing first-use evidence. No duplicate/overlapping parcel protection or consistency between claimed species/variety; rate/year data separately audited.

Strict>15%, DIV beyond7% counting, descending rates and40% total cap follow p25 example exactly. NPF and OP areas excluded from threshold as well as payment, not explicitly justified by source wording; other-measure/LSE-only parcel exclusions not uniformly applied.

Supplied fwk_main_component controls mixed-crop group without any proportion or predominantly-eligible-legume evidence check; required mown-fed mixed-forage Sonstiges Feldfutter classification not enforced.

Set of main/second groups chooses higher rate and each parcel contributes area once. Generic BHG/seed-harvest evidence is only checked for main crop, so second autochthonous case needs separate explicit representation.
NPF excludes payment only through2024. Its exclusion from15% threshold is a separate documented interpretation concern in FWK001.

Closed BHG list referenced for named crops. Autochthonous_seed_production boolean plus harvest flag accepts any species, without checking chapter14 list. Literal placeholder strings in crop data are executable group values rather than actual plant names (tables audit).

Generic Heil-/Gewürzpflanzen/Sonstige Ackerkulturen needs BHG+recognized crop. It does not forbid unnecessary BHG coding on crops with their own use type or represent the source of crop_name as MFA additional text.
BHG plus autochthonous-seed production and no seed harvest explicitly diagnosed. However seed-species listing and second-crop treatment remain FWK005/003 gaps.

Most row/crop/no-undersow/season restrictions represented, but harvest_whole_plant uses shortened management window ending earlier thresh. A June whole-plant harvest after prior thresh passes despite fixed until-June30 only-thresh requirement (MEASURE-06). Double ordinary row spacing not checked beyond20cm aggregate minimum. Additionally, explicit null threshing_date nullifies the entire restriction window and accepts known March PSM use (MEASURE-08), although the native proposed profile permits date|null.
Eligible area capped20ha per farm and multiplied by yearly270/250rate. Basic WB eligibility conflict still affects amount.

>=15/ha,installation<=14days,>=35days,2empties,removal/documentation/lure-receipts/breakup aggregates checked. Emptying dates not constrained to minimum field period; actual bait/container not checked. Annual purchase does not prove application. Trap-retention usesSep30 while supplied older SRL says end vegetation period (already unresolved in native assumptions). Negative/older installation date passes latest-only comparison.
150€/ha from2025 rate applied; statutory compliance is catalog advisory, not independently proved by pzr_eligible.
Pure paid DIV excludes GLÖZ4 and other-measure DIV; same cap/subtraction order as arable yields maximum13% area. Need source cap interpretation, not a proven code error without legal review.
Supplied mean soil index>=30 and20% mown-grassland cap applied. Weighted mean calculation/official layer not executed.
Ceil(mown/3),strict>0.05ha,20% paid area implemented; counting credited NAT/EBW/N2 areas is explicit native assumption, field/parcel count identity requires authoritative input.
20% cap and2025+150rate; exclusion checks only AGF-prefixed violations, not missing annual removed mowing or other general constraints. Raw altgras premium may remain even with BW002 violation.
20% mown area cap andyearrate implemented, but divrs_eligible omits removed-cleaning-cut use count (MEASURE-02) and annual removed-mow requirement. Native raw amount is not a compliance release.
Slope>=50,use-type allowlist and once-annual mowing supplied event/boolean checked. Slope is whole-parcel aggregate; official layer/subparcel majority not derived. OP/LSE-only exclusion present.
50€/ha grant controlled by supplied granted boolean. Timely regional notification/available resources not represented; final legal assessment belongs to general-agent SRL review.
Nonfallow arable base plus DIV Grünbrache up to20% of denominator, times yearrate. Native raw component not suppressed by all violations; overall admission handled separately.

Area>0.50ha,slope>=10,crop list/provided category and measure8+method(+6/7for mulch/direct/strip) implemented. Average slope scalar is not explicitly predominant-slope layer; other_measure_8_method asserted without method-specific evidence.
Eligible grassland area times livestock/nonlivestock yearrate. Livestock classification and missing animal data are audited separately; code labels are raw not approved payments.

No-premium/othermeasure/K20/Sonstige/outsideAustria checks present; full area exclusions and crop labels belong to legal/general audit. Supplements do not all share not_eligible_area, a cross-module payment gap.

Code implements weighted size factor across summed domestic nonalpine parcel area, then rounds gross total. Denominator legal meaning, doublecounting special areas and unmodulated component exceptions belong to general review.

Only compares supplied total_area_payments_eur_per_ha against standard or NAT/EBW case; no automatic cap allocation in premium, no required total input, no K20/beneficial-insect special-case selection here. General audit determines exact scope.

Rechtsform und direkte numerische Beteiligung werden geprüft; aktive Landwirtschaft, Tätigkeit, eigene Rechnung/Verfügungsgewalt und mittelbarer/organisatorischer öffentlicher Einfluss fehlen. Fehlende Rechtsform/share werden günstig vorbelegt.

0,50/1,50-ha-Grenzen und Beschränkung auf das erste ÖPUL-Jahr stimmen. Summe nimmt beliebige inländische parcels ohne Nutzungsprüfung; kein historischer Erstjahresnachweis und fehlendes erstes Jahr überspringt Prüfung.
Verstoß sagt außerhalb Österreichs werde nicht berücksichtigt, während Flächenaggregate und FWK-Prämie diese Flächen berücksichtigen. Nicht nur fehlende UI-Warnung.
Konditionalität und soziale Konditionalität stehen ohne Rego im Katalog. Ein Vorjahres-Auditflag wäre kein gleichwertiger aktueller Nachweis.
85%-Ernte auf nicht ausgenommenem Acker wird geprüft; fehlender Ernteanteil wird 100. Ordnungsgemäßer Anbau/Pflege und geschützter Anbau außerhalb arable_parcels fehlen.

Ein beliebiges mow+material_removed/graze im Jahr genügt ohne Vollflächigkeit. Fehlende use_events überspringen den Verstoß; explizit [] erzeugt ihn. Nichtproduktive Flächen/zweijährliche Pflege nicht allgemein umgesetzt.

Fallow withoutDIV excluded from base, other exclusion predicates partially apply. Active management, energy wood and nursery exclusions require general-source review and cannot be proved from this assigned infosheet alone.
Weitergabe ohne Weiterführung erzeugt OP/OPUBB-Hinweis; kein positiver Ganzjahresnachweis und ohne Codierung kein Ausschluss des berechneten Geldbetrags.

Der vorgeschlagene third_party_fault-Flag wird nicht gelesen. OP oder Selbstanzeige wird für beide Ursachen als Alternative akzeptiert, entgegen der unterschiedlichen Quellvorgaben. Code-Löschung wird nicht geprüft.

5%/max5ha/mind0,50ha und Rückzahlungs-Differenzfläche stimmen bei voraggregierten zulässigen Abgängen. Rückzahlungswert wird im decision nicht ausgegeben; Verwaltungsanerkennung der Ausnahmen ist extern.
Betriebsübertragung/Fortführung/solidarische Haftung sind nicht ausgeführt. Verlust der Verfügungsgewalt darf daher nicht pauschal für Personenwechsel angenommen werden.
2024/25 ganz, danach50%/mind5ha plus vorherverpflichtete Fläche werden berechnet. Die errechnete Grenze begrenzt premium.net nicht und fehlt in decision; fehlende Basis2025 wird0.
Helfer prüft Bio-Umwandlungsdatum bis31.12.2025; Rückzahlungsausnahme verwendet nur reason=conversion_to_bio und verknüpft diesen Helfer nicht.
15.04./17.04.-Fristen sind korrekt. Bisherige Nichtteilnahme, Genehmigung und Restlaufzeit werden nicht positiv geprüft; der Verstoß ist kein Zugangsgate.
>50%-Ausweitung wird korrekt als Verstoß erfasst; fehlt in access_rule_ids und begrenzt Betrag nicht.
Monitoring-Übernahme mit nicht zugelassenem reason erzeugt Verstoß. Einzelfallgenehmigung und Zahlungsfolge werden nicht geprüft.

Vorzeitiger Austritt/Rückzahlungsgrund ist nur Helfer, nicht Gesamtentscheidung; Jahresungültigkeit, Ausstieg bisKontrolle, Wiedereinstieg und Voraussetzungen einzelner Ausnahmen sind nicht umgesetzt.
Fristgerechte Korrektur unmöglicher Kombinationen und Auflagenfortführung sind nur Textkatalog.

Sanktionsstufen einschließlich Verwarnung0/1ab2027 und zweimal100%-Ausschluss sind korrekt abrufbar. Keine Stufenzuordnung/Anwendung in decision; mangels Schwerebewertung ist kein beliebiger Nullbetrag ableitbar.
30.06.Folgejahr und0,75 werden korrekt berechnet; abgeschlossene Verwaltungskontrolle/Kontoinhaber/Übergabe sind Verfahrensbedingungen, kein automatischer Zahlungsanspruch.
Explizit fehlender Zahlungsantrag und mehrals1JahrVerspätung werden in Helfern erkannt, bleiben aber außerhalb decision/premium.net. Quelle schließt aktuelle Zahlung ausdrücklich aus.
